#4.imputation
```{r}
# 2.7 Imputation
rnb.norm.impute <- rnb.execute.imputation(rnb.norm, method = "knn", update.ff = TRUE)
```
#5. SVA
```{r}
svaObj <- rnb.execute.sva(rnb.norm.impute, cmp.cols="Sample_Group", numSVmethod="be")
rnbs.sva <- set.covariates.sva(rnb.norm.impute, svaObj)
get.covariates.sva(rnbs.sva, "Sample_Group")
```

#6. DMP
```{r}
dm.sva <- rnb.execute.computeDiffMeth(rnbs.sva, "Sample_Group")
```
